question: Using Apple's FY2025 Q2 10-Q, calculate total net sales growth from the three months ended March 30, 2024 to the three months ended March 29, 2025. Return a percentage rounded to two decimal places.
tool_required: sec-edgar-toolkit (filing text and table extraction) + calculation
reasoning: Compute (current-quarter sales / prior-year comparable-quarter sales - 1) * 100 using the reported USD-million figures.
evidence: AAPL Form 10-Q, FY2025 Q2; quarter ended 2025-03-29; Part I, Item 1, Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations, total net sales row, both three-month columns.

question: Using Apple's FY2025 Q2 10-Q, calculate its consolidated operating margin for the three months ended March 29, 2025. Return a percentage rounded to two decimal places.
tool_required: sec-edgar-toolkit (filing text and table extraction) + calculation
reasoning: Compute quarterly consolidated operating income / quarterly total net sales * 100. Do not substitute segment operating income.
evidence: AAPL Form 10-Q, FY2025 Q2; quarter ended 2025-03-29; Part I, Item 1, Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations, operating income and total net sales rows.

question: Using Apple's FY2025 Q2 10-Q, calculate the current ratio as of March 29, 2025. Return the ratio rounded to four decimal places.
tool_required: sec-edgar-toolkit (filing text and table extraction) + calculation
reasoning: Divide total current assets by total current liabilities at the same date; use consistent units.
evidence: AAPL Form 10-Q, FY2025 Q2; quarter ended 2025-03-29; Part I, Item 1, Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheets, total current assets and total current liabilities rows.

question: Using Apple's FY2025 Q2 10-Q, calculate Services net sales as a percentage of total net sales for the three months ended March 29, 2025. Return a percentage rounded to two decimal places.
tool_required: sec-edgar-toolkit (filing text and table extraction) + calculation
reasoning: Compute quarterly Services sales / quarterly total sales * 100, using the same period for both inputs.
evidence: AAPL Form 10-Q, FY2025 Q2; quarter ended 2025-03-29; Part I, Item 1, Note 2 - Revenue, Services and total net sales rows, three-month column.

question: Using only Apple's FY2025 Q2 10-Q, derive FY2025 Q1 total net sales by subtracting second-quarter sales from six-month sales, then calculate Q2 versus Q1 sales growth. Return derived Q1 sales in USD millions and sequential growth as a percentage rounded to two decimal places.
tool_required: sec-edgar-toolkit (filing text and table extraction) + calculation
reasoning: First compute Q1 = six-month sales - Q2 sales; then compute (Q2 / Q1 - 1) * 100. This tests a dependent calculation and distinguishes year-to-date from quarterly amounts.
evidence: AAPL Form 10-Q, FY2025 Q2; quarter ended 2025-03-29; Part I, Item 1, Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations, total net sales row, 2025 six-month and three-month columns.
